== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text (the PC website card list). '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-37-Hyperwave_Scan.png]]) and the Master List (2013) show the words of [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Block 1)]] and the current text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words, and its straight quote marks, are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. During opponent's move phase, may use 3 Force to peek at opponent's hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not place those cards in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch C2/C3 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
